resources.string: BurnOut" is a cutting-edge gym application focused on enhancing your fitness journey. With modules dedicated to Workouts and BMI Calculation, it offers a comprehensive solution for achieving your fitness goals. What sets "BurnOut" apart is its dedication to user privacy. Unlike many fitness apps, "BurnOut" does not collect any personal data. Instead, all user data is securely stored on the device, ensuring maximum privacy and confidentiality. The app also boasts offline functionality, allowing users to access and perform workouts without an internet connection. Stay tuned for future updates, including modules for Yoga and Nutrition, as "BurnOut" continues to evolve as your ultimate fitness companion.\n\nThanks
